_comment: SWARM Messenger staging endpoints. This file is the source of truth for the SWARM endpoint set. node-config picks files by NODE_ENV, and 'swarm-staging' is not a NODE_ENV, so config/default.json and config/production.json carry the same endpoint values; ts/test-node/swarm/endpointGuard_test.node.ts fails if they drift apart. Read docs/SWARM-CONFIG.md before editing.
_placeholders: Every value starting with SWARM-PLACEHOLDER- is server-generated and must come from Opus M-B's shared/staging-public-params.json. The app refuses to start while any placeholder is still present.
